audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Camille/Skill/Yasuo/Yasuo/Camille/Yasuo/Yasuo. It disagreed with the packet chart and with this page's own text on three rows: whys[1] says Level 2 still favours Camille, whys[2] says Level 3 only evens the lane, and whys[6] plus spikes[3] and late all say Camille pulls ahead late.
audit.why: Precision Protocol's two-hit and Tactical Sweep out-damage Yasuo before he has an E target; Level 3 gives him disengage, not control; late, R isolation plus Q true damage beats a crit build in a 1v1.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Camille, Level 2 Camille, Level 3 Skill, Levels 4-5 Yasuo, Level 6 Camille, First item Yasuo, 2+ items Camille. Matches the packet chart. Rows proposed as a matched full+content group.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2] and phases[6] were generic template text ('your core pattern starts now', 'your side-lane pattern is at full power') that asserted Yasuo spikes the page's own late-game text denies.
audit.why: Level 3 is a disengage spike, not a control spike, and it is gated on Hookshot's 16s rank-1 cooldown. The two-item window belongs to Camille, whose R isolation and true damage scale past a crit build.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why now names Hookshot's 16s window; phases[6].why states Camille still picks the fight and gives the close-it-out instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three ability mix-ups. spikes[0] called the wall-dash 'Tactical Sweep (E)' — Tactical Sweep is her W, the E is Hookshot. spikes[0] and wants.foe[2] put the true damage on W; it is on Precision Protocol (Q). spikes[2] called the shield 'her Q shield'; the shield is Adaptive Defenses (P). Worse, three places told the player to Wind Wall her Q.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Adaptive Defenses (P, shield vs the damage type that hit her), Precision Protocol (Q, empowered auto, true damage, auto-reset), Tactical Sweep (W, cone, slows and heals her), Hookshot (E, wall-dash knockup, 16/15/14/13/12), The Hextech Ultimatum (R, 140/115/90). Precision Protocol is an empowered basic attack, so Wind Wall cannot block it — telling the player to bank a 25s wall for it wastes their only defensive cooldown.
audit.corrected: Names corrected throughout; the Q described as an empowered auto whose wind-up you step back from rather than wall; W credited with the heal, not true damage; Hookshot's 16s cooldown written in as the punish window.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Hextech Ultimatum' in wants.foe[1]. False positive — the string reads 'the Hextech Ultimatum', which is the full name The Hextech Ultimatum with lowercase article.

edits.before: E dashes through minions make you untouchable in the wave. Only take the trade when Camille's Hookshot is down.
edits.after: Her Q two-hit and Tactical Sweep out-trade you and you have no E target yet. Farm and stay off the walls.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Camille must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: E-Q disengage evens it out, but her Hookshot is 16s at rank 1 — fight only in the gap right after she spends it.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Camille carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, Camille still picks the fight: R isolation plus Q true damage. Carry threat 9/10 — close the game before she scales.

edits.before: Camille's early Precision Protocol (Q) two-hit and Tactical Sweep (E) wall-dash out-trade you before you have items, and her W true damage cone shreds your health bar. By level 3 it evens as your E-Q lets you disengage, and at 4 you can punish her when E is on cooldown — but respect her when it's up. Don't fight near walls where her E hooks you.
edits.after: Camille's early Precision Protocol (Q) two-hit and Hookshot (E) wall-dash out-trade you before you have items, and that Q's true damage shreds your health bar. By level 3 it evens as your E-Q lets you disengage, and at 4 you can punish her when Hookshot is 16s down — but respect her when it's up. Don't fight near walls where her E hooks you.

edits.before: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) traps you in a zone with no escape — a clean isolation all-in that swings level 6 back to her. You can't E out of the R zone, so save Wind Wall for her Q crit and try to burst her before the trap damage ramps, or she wins the exchange.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) traps you in a zone with no escape — a clean isolation all-in that swings level 6 back to her. You can't E out of the R zone, and her Q is an empowered auto Wind Wall cannot stop, so burst her before the trap damage ramps or she wins the exchange.

edits.before: Your crit spike flips a window: E-Q resets and crit autos out-DPS her once her Q shield and E are down. Wall her Q empowered hit and stick to her, but don't get caught by a wall-dash E stun.
edits.after: Your crit spike flips a window: E-Q resets and crit autos out-DPS her once Adaptive Defenses and her E are down. Step back on her Q wind-up and stick to her, but don't get caught by a wall-dash E stun.

edits.before: It swings: at 3 your E-Q evens the disengage, at 4 you punish her E cooldown, but The Hextech Ultimatum at 6 traps and isolates you back in her favour. Fight when her E is down, avoid her R zone, and wall her empowered Q.
edits.after: It swings: at 3 your E-Q evens the disengage, at 4 you punish her E cooldown, but The Hextech Ultimatum at 6 traps and isolates you back in her favour. Fight when her E is down, avoid her R zone, and step back on her Q wind-up.

edits.before: At 4 you can punish Camille when Tactical Sweep is on cooldown.
edits.after: At 4 you can punish Camille when her 16s Hookshot is down.

edits.before: Punish her when Tactical Sweep is on cooldown
edits.after: Punish her when the 16s Hookshot is down

edits.before: Use W true-damage shred and E stun near terrain
edits.after: Use Q true damage and Hookshot near terrain

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Hookshot needs terrain — in open ground her engage is just a 16s dash.

notes: Camille's kit file carries a derived projectile flag on Hookshot, but Riot's own description ('pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing') describes no projectile. Per the file's own rule I trusted the description and did NOT write that Wind Wall blocks Hookshot; I also did not write that it cannot. The mirror audit hit the same wall. Left as unverified. What I did remove is the claim that Wind Wall stops Precision Protocol — that is an empowered basic attack and the wall demonstrably does not apply.
